thread.title: Four arrested in Montes Jr murder case

title: Four arrested in Montes Jr murder case
text:
SALTON SEA– The Imperial County Sheriff’s Office Investigations Unit has been working diligently on the case involving the death of Pedro Montes Jr., according to a recent ICSO press release.
Through extensive investigative efforts, including the review of digital evidence, physical evidence, and statements from involved parties, investigators identified four individuals connected to the homicide.
The Imperial County Sheriff’s Office conducted an operation on Tuesday, May 26, around 11:30 a.m., resulting in the arrest of all four identified suspects. Investigators first located Andrew Gallegos, 55, a resident of Salton City, at his place of employment in the Salton City area. He was taken into custody without incident.
Investigators then served a search warrant at a residence located in the 2400 block of Shore Hawk Avenue in Salton City, where they contacted and arrested Robert Gallegos, 57, and Crystal Hernandez, 37. Investigators later located Blanca Robles, 53, at a nearby business where she was also arrested.
All four subjects named were previously identified as persons of interest in the case. All four individuals were arrested, interviewed, and booked into the Imperial County Jail. Andrew Gallegos was booked for 187(a) PC-Murder and is being held on a $1-million bail. Robert Gallegos, Crystal Hernandez and Blanca Robles were all booked for 187(a) PCMurder and 32 PC-Accessory After the Fact and are also being held on $1 million bail.
This case remains an active investigation. No further details will be released at this time to protect the integrity of the case. Anyone with additional information is requested to contact Investigator Aguirre at telephone number (442) 265-2046.
